messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 10:04 UTC - Elevated ELB connection resets and increased 5xxs observed in eu-west-1b across multiple customer-facing pools. Auto-scaling triggered for a subset of Dedicated hosts. PagerDuty: p99 latency > 2s.
maya: Ack. I'm on-call. Paging infra + networking. Any early ETA on root cause?
sam: Looking at ENI/host networking now. I'm seeing a spike in RxErrors and ARP churn on hosts in eu-west-1b (lots of retransmits).
riju: Route53 metrics look weird too — some weighted routing shifts aren't propagating cleanly to clients, TTLs were low but clients still hitting broken backends. Could be a combination of AZ-level networking flaps + DNS caching.
henry: Customer impact: several API customers report increased 502/504, some webhooks failing. Not universal. Estimating 6-12% traffic impacted for eu-west-1 region. Recommend immediate mitigations: 1) shift Route53 weighted traffic away from eu-west-1b -> eu-west-1a/us-east-1 2) drain and detach ENIs on affected hosts 3) open AWS support case.
maya: Agreed. I'll do the DNS shift. sam, can you isolate affected hosts and start draining? riju, can you confirm no config drift in our Route53 health checks?
sam: On it. Starting a graceful drain of target groups in the affected ELBs. Using this:
```
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn <tg-arn> --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30 --region eu-west-1
for tg in $(cat affected-tgs.txt); do aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn $tg --targets Id=$(aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn $tg --region eu-west-1 --query 'TargetHealthDescriptions[?TargetHealth.State==`healthy`].Target.Id' --output text) --region eu-west-1; done
```
sam: Also scaling up healthy hosts in eu-west-1a to absorb shifted traffic.
riju: Checked Route53 health checks config — no recent changes. TTLs are 30s for the weighted record. Some clients still holding onto older endpoints though. I can push a weighted-change with higher weight to other AZs.
henry: Let's do a temporary weighted re-route: 0% to eu-west-1b, 60% eu-west-1a, 40% us-east-1. Keep TTL at 30s and monitor p50/p95. riju, can you apply and share the change-batch?
riju: Applying now. Change-batch payload attached.
```json
{
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "api.redwood.example.com",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "eu-west-1a",
        "Weight": 60,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value":"54.12.34.1"}]
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "api.redwood.example.com",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "us-east-1",
        "Weight": 40,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value":"3.5.6.7"}]
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "api.redwood.example.com",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "eu-west-1b",
        "Weight": 0,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value":"18.23.45.6"}]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
riju: Change submitted via `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch file://shift.json`. Change ID: CZZX12345. Expect propagation within ~30s-60s but client cache may persist.
maya: Updating status page: "Partial impact to API endpoints in eu-west-1 — we are mitigating by shifting traffic to healthy AZs."
pagerduty: Incident assigned to maya (oncall) and sam (infra). Severity: S2.
sam: Drains in progress. Noting some ELB instances still reporting target health flaps (502s). I suspect an underlying ENI/host NIC driver problem causing packet drops. I've isolated 6 hosts and flagged for replacement.
henry: Opening AWS support case now, providing ENI metrics + pcap snippets. Case ref: 9876543210.
support-bot: AWS Support case 9876543210 created. Initial response SLA: 30 minutes.
maya: Handoff — I need to step out for 20m (pager duty scheduled maintenance). Sam, taking on the primary incident lead. Riju, keep DNS and weight changes under watch. I'll be reachable by phone.
sam: Taking lead. Monitoring metrics: p50/p95 improving in region as weighted change propagates. 502 rate dropped from 9% -> 2.5% in the last 5m.
riju: Route53 change status: INSYNC. Still seeing some client-side errors (likely cached entries). We'll keep traffic at 0% to eu-west-1b until AWS confirms network stability.
henry: Action items logged to incident tracker: replace affected hosts, run NIC firmware validation across eu-west-1, update autoscale policies to prefer healthy AZs until further notice.
maya: Noted. I'm posting follow-up to customers with impacted SLAs in the next update (15m).
sam: Will continue draining and replacing hosts. If AWS confirms wider fabric issue, we'll coordinate cross-region failover later.
incident-bot: Status update 10:30 UTC: Mitigation applied (Route53 weighted shift, target drains). Customer impact reduced. Working with AWS on root cause.
maya: Closing primary paging. If anyone gets new alerts escalate back to this thread. We'll declare incident retrospective & postmortem after AWS root cause and host replacements. :white_check_mark:
